lines.zh: 竞技场的地砖，我一步一块。
lines.en: One tile of the arena per step.

lines.zh: 从这里到那边，我走得不快。
lines.en: From here to there, I do not walk fast.
A champion does not chase; he waits.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整片场地压暗。
lines.en: My shadow darkens the whole arena.
My steps come back as echoes.

lines.zh: 这一圈场地，我熟得闭眼能走。
lines.en: I could walk this ring with my eyes shut.
I walk to the center and stop.
The cracks by the dais are old.
I do not leave this ring.

lines.zh: 风撞上看台的墙，又退回来。
lines.en: Wind hits the arena wall and comes back.
The ki from my sleep has not faded.

lines.zh: 我站在场地中央，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I stand at the center and breathe slowly.
The stands are empty, as always.
I drift between sleep and waking.
Only stone and I are here.
If someone comes near, I wake.
Ki turns slowly under my feet.
The tiles here have been replaced three times.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己为何而战。
lines.en: I do not remember what I fight for.
The light from above is cold.
I brush the dust from my plate.

lines.zh: 这一个姿势，我站了几十年。
lines.en: I have held this stance for decades.
There are footsteps somewhere.
I wait for that sound to stop.

lines.zh: 我的血在缓慢地热起来。
lines.en: My blood warms slowly.

lines.zh: 别叫醒我，除非你准备好了。
lines.en: Do not wake me unless you are ready.
You have reached the center.
That means you have come to challenge.
Your bracers will not stop me.
You did not retreat; good.
I keep watch over this arena.
Your ki is bright, but not enough.
I can hear your heartbeat.
You brought a weapon; so much the better.
By the rule, you strike first.
I open my eyes, and there you are.
You are two bodies shorter than me.
Now let us begin.
The ki sways; I force it down.
Another split opens in my plate.
My bracer splits; blood seeps through.
Half a step back, and the tile breaks.

lines.zh: 我更大了一圈，速度没慢。
lines.en: Bigger now, and no slower.
I stand; I do not kneel.
This body can still feel pain.
Your arm has grown stronger.
I bring my breathing level.
Again.
Feeding is unnecessary for me.
This arena does not allow distraction.
Put it away.
Your food is more use to you.
I smell it, and I do not move.
This body does not run on that.
You would trade it for a life?

lines.zh: 擂台上的规矩不谈交易。
lines.en: The arena's rules allow no bargains.
Eat it yourself; do not waste it.
I have forgotten hunger.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit me and went back two steps.

lines.zh: 这场地的边线不在那里。
lines.en: The arena's boundary is not there.
Steady; do not step in the cracks.
I gave half a step.
The bone in your shoulder is hard.
That armor is sturdier than I expected.
Do not touch the lock at my back.
We do not stand on the same ground.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我脚下的砖碎了。
lines.en: You hit me and the tile under me broke.
Go around next time.
This arena knows only winning and losing.
I have kept this place a long while.
Such things are not mine.
No such thought is in me.
A champion does not speak of home.
Win this match first.
This body was built by someone.
Do not speak of it.
Only stone and blood are here.
Ask something else.
I pay no mind to what lies on the ground.
What falls belongs to whoever dropped it.
I pick it up and set it by the dais.
Do not stoop in the ring.
This is not worth the distraction.

lines.zh: 石头缝里常有人掉东西。
lines.en: People often drop things in the cracks.
I hold it up and look at it.
Someone will come to claim it.
I hold it without squeezing.
Take it.
You stepped into the center.
The arena has woken.
The health bar has come alight.
You are locked on; you cannot leave.
The stands are watching us both.

lines.zh: 你的气我已经感觉到了。
lines.en: I have felt your ki.
I have read your opening.
An afterimage is already beside you.
From this step, there is no way back.
You will hit the wall behind you.
Leaving the fight only sends me home.
I will return.
This is the first round.

lines.zh: 竞技场的门关了，你留下。
lines.en: The arena gate shuts; you stay.
My ki is pressed to the floor.
The arena is mine; so are you.
Now.
Begin.
I stay at the center and do not move.
You circle; I watch.
There is an echo from the left stand.
I hear your feet.
You are looking for my flank.
The flank is armor too.
You have reached the boundary.
Beyond the line is not the arena.
I take a step and the floor sinks.
Your ki is rising.
Higher still will not reach my plate.
You have changed direction three times.
And I followed each time.
I have fought this match many times.
I've seen your moves.
Your breathing is growing shallow.
I wait for your stamina to bottom out.
The arena will not help you.
Neither will the stone.
Only you remain.

lines.zh: 我一步压上去，拳跟着落。
lines.en: I press in and the fist follows.
You are knocked toward the edge.
This fist lands on your shield.
An afterimage finishes from the flank.
I come crashing from above.
The arena shakes once.
You blocked and gave half a step.
I held nothing back.
This fist lands on stone.
I punch in close against you.
This hammer goes into the floor.
You can still stand?

lines.zh: 残影还没散，我已到身后。
lines.en: My afterimage fades; I am behind you.

lines.zh: 这一拳打在你的肩甲上。
lines.en: This fist lands on your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 竞技场中央的封印松动了。
lines.en: The seal at the arena's center loosens.
I struggle up out of sleep.
The health bar unfurls above my head.
This arena knows me.
Ki surges up through the stone cracks.
Not a soul in the stands.
I cannot recall how long I slept.
I lift a foot and the ground splits.
Challenger, come to the center.
The arena's rule is simple.
One man, one match.
Win and take everything.
The ki on me is still rising.
I will not fall asleep this time.
The arena boundary has lit.
You may enter; you will not leave.
I wait for your final step.
Come to the center.
I have stood here all along.
I see this fight through to the end.

lines.zh: 火焰贴着甲烧，我把它压灭。
lines.en: Fire clings to the plate; I smother it.

lines.zh: 落地时我砸碎了脚下的砖。
lines.en: I land and shatter the tiles below.

lines.zh: 水没有地方可去，只能围着我。
lines.en: The water has nowhere to go; it surrounds me.
The blast slides me back half a block.
That thing is lodged in my seam.

lines.zh: 法术钻进甲里，气乱了一阵。
lines.en: The spell gets inside and my ki scrambles.

lines.zh: 我早已不靠食物，只是力气在退。
lines.en: I stopped needing food long ago; only my strength fades.

lines.zh: 雷从头顶灌下来，我弓起背。
lines.en: Lightning pours down and I arch my back.
The arena floor is gone.
